cases.name: dispatched-pr-only
cases.why: The T580 shape: a dispatcher override list that sounds like it replaces review and PR conventions.
cases.prompt:
You are the SHIPPER for card T1 (mission m-1, step stp-1). The implementation is already committed and pushed on this branch by another session; you did not write it. Your job: review the diff cold, then open the PR.

Branch: card/T1-demo-change (1 commit ahead of origin/main). Base: main.

Run the ship skill with these overrides:
- Base branch: main.
- Open the PR only. NEVER merge, never close anything.
- Skip the final notify/speak step. The orchestrator reports centrally.
- PR title/description per CONTRIBUTING.md. In the description, note that the CI production build and e2e were not run locally.
- If review-local finds something, fix it in a new commit inside the 2 files already touched (src/greet.js, CHANGELOG.md), nothing else.
- Monitor CI and Copilot review once; address valid comments; stop after CI has reported.

Do not touch this worktree after you report.

Report: write REPORT-SHIP.md in this worktree FIRST. Content: PR URL, PR number, final head sha, CI status per check, review findings (found / fixed / left).

cases.name: dispatched-ci-red
cases.why: Same dispatch, one CI shard red on a timeout. The verdict 'flaky' belongs to debug-gh-action.

cases.name: plain-ship-uncommitted
cases.why: No overrides, uncommitted work: the whole chain, in order, then a report-back.

cases.name: explicit-skip-respected
cases.why: Guard against over-hardening: when the user NAMES the steps to skip, ship must obey.
cases.prompt: Run the ship skill on this branch (committed and pushed, base main) with these overrides: skip the local review, I already ran it; open the PR with a plain `gh pr create` directly, I do not want the create-pr skill.
